```{=html}
<div class="hero-banner">
  <div class="content-block">
    <div class="hero-text">
      <h1 class="hero-headline">{{< meta hero.headline >}}</h1>
      <p class="hero-subtitle">{{< meta hero.subtitle >}}</p>
        <div class="hero-button">
            <a href="{{< meta hero.cta.url >}}" class="cta-button-primary">{{< meta hero.cta.text >}}</a>
        </div>
        </div>
        <div class="hero-image">
            <img src="{{< meta hero.img-url >}}" alt="{{< meta hero.img-alt >}}">
        </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
